question: How do I submit a new ticket?
answer: You can submit a new ticket by navigating to the "Submit Ticket" section and filling out the required information, including the issue description, priority, and any relevant attachments.

question: How can I check the status of my existing tickets?
answer: To check the status of your tickets, go to the "My Tickets" or "Dashboard" section. You will see a list of all your submitted tickets along with their current status (e.g., Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed).

question: Can I add more information to an already submitted ticket?
answer: Yes, you can add comments or attachments to an existing ticket. Navigate to the ticket details page and use the "Add Comment" or "Attach File" options.

question: What should I do if my ticket is not resolved within the expected timeframe?
answer: If your ticket is taking longer than expected, you can escalate it through the system or contact support directly, referencing your ticket number.

question: How do I close a ticket?
answer: Once your issue is resolved, you can close the ticket from its details page. You may also be prompted to provide feedback on the resolution.
